title: Big XOR
statement: The task picks which of 1..n to double so the final XOR is at least twice their OR (n ≤ 2·10^5). That OR is 2^L−1 and every value stays below 2^(L+1), so XOR bits 1..L must all be set. This forces the doubled elements' XOR s to satisfy s XOR (s>>1) = fixed target, a Gray-code inversion done from the top bit and realised by doubling powers of two.
